title: Pennsylvania governor says Eagles will remain in the city of Philadelphia "for sure"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Pennsylvania governor says Eagles will remain in the city of Philadelphia "for sure"
sources.description: At a time when the Chiefs are preparing to leave Kansas City, Missouri, for Kansas City, Kansas, the Browns are preparing to leave Cleveland for Brook Park, Ohio, and the Bears are preparing to leave Chicago for a suburban site in either Illinois or Indiana, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro says there's no chance of the Eagles leaving the city of Philadelphia.
